annotations.title: Make a clip of a saved person

description: Puts a saved person on screen and returns a job: talking has them speak a line, motion has them move as a reference clip moves, swap puts them in place of the person in a clip, and product shows them holding a product (a picture). Without a quote, returns the cost and makes nothing. With a held quote, spends the account's credits; a talking clip costs about what its avatar model costs (ugcfans_list_models, kind avatar). The person must be saved with a portrait and, if real, recorded consent at https://ugc.fans/library. motion and swap need rights_confirmed: true, given only after the person confirms they may use the source clip.

brand.description: product: the id of a saved brand whose kit holds the product pictures.

handling.description: product: how the person has it.

image.description: talking: which picture of the person to use, out/...

motion_from.description: motion: follow the clip itself or its pose (default clip).

note.description: swap: what to change, in words.

person.description: The id of the saved person.

product_images.description: product: pictures of the product, out/...

quote.description: The held quote for this exact request, after the person confirms its cost.

rights_confirmed.description: motion and swap: the person confirms they may use the source clip.

script.description: talking: the id of a saved script to speak.

setting.description: motion and product: where it happens.

source.description: motion and swap: the reference clip's address, out/...

speech.description: talking: the id of a saved line to use as the audio.

voice.description: talking, with script or text: the id of the saved voice to speak in.
